answer_1.quote: Data-To-Text Generation involves converting knowledge graph (KG) triples of the form (subject, relation, object) into a natural language sentence(s).
answer_1.outputs: natural language sentences from knowledge graph triples

answer_4.quote: Generation quality of the KELM Corpus is evaluated using human ratings on a random sample of 200 entity subgraphs.
answer_4.guideline: the generated text is rated for two aspects-fluency and semantics, on a scale of 1-5, where 1 means not at all fluent/does not capture meaning at all and 5 means completely fluent/fully captures meaning with no hallucination.
